contract: stage bank keyed by transfer function. key = rounded (b0,b1,b2,a1,a2) of H_k(z) at the 39,062.5 Hz datum, so any corpus stage resolves exactly and totally. The operation a stage performs depends on the stages before it, so it is carried per entry as a distribution over the contexts the corpus puts that stage in, never as the key.

bypass.structure: H(z) = 1 exactly: the identity row the corpus parks in unused stage slots

transparent.structure: leaves the running cascade where it was

resonance.structure: adds a resonant peak and little else

resonance + guard zero.structure: adds a resonant peak with a companion null

resonance over low cut.structure: adds a peak while removing level below 80 Hz

resonance over high cut.structure: adds a peak while removing level above 12 kHz

null.structure: carves a null, adds no resonance

null relocation.structure: removes one null and opens another elsewhere

resonance removal.structure: cancels a resonance the earlier stages built

broadband tilt.structure: moves the two band edges in opposite directions
